mutations.title: zero executed cases reported as PASS
mutations.detector: harness.finish converts a 0-case PASS to UNRESOLVED and fails the test
mutations.rationale: The Phase-1B requirement: an unexecuted test is not a pass.
mutations.evidence: pytest exit 1; E           AssertionError: [UNRESOLVED] MAT02 (1-data-integrity): claims a pass without executing anything; E             detail:   FORCED UNRESOLVED: 0 cases executed, so a PASS or NOT_APPLICABLE would be unevidenced.

mutations.title: incorrect characteristic-matrix parity (e33 sign in M[1,2])
mutations.detector: M(-xi) = S M(xi) S must fail for the unique admitted S
mutations.rationale: This is the Phase-1 defect class: a coupling sign that breaks parity.
mutations.evidence: parity entries broken by the mutation: 1
mutations.control_evidence: parity entries broken by the mutation: 0

mutations.title: incorrect heat-flux expression (linear thermal term)
mutations.detector: check_D2_balance must not report PASS
mutations.rationale: The Phase-1 P0 defect, re-injected. The detector is the Second-Law balance, which shares no amplitude with the flux.
mutations.evidence: D2 status under the mutated flux: FAIL (n_exec=2, worst rel. residual 1.00e+00)
mutations.control_evidence: mutation did not apply (no marker found)

mutations.title: wrong polynomial coefficient ordering
mutations.detector: the returned roots must not satisfy det M = 0
mutations.rationale: polyroots expects descending coefficients; feeding ascending ones returns roots of a different polynomial.
mutations.evidence: worst relative polynomial residual at the returned roots: 1.000e+00
mutations.control_evidence: worst relative polynomial residual at the returned roots: 1.398e-41

mutations.title: incorrect incident/outgoing mode selection
mutations.detector: _admissible must not return a growing mode
mutations.rationale: Swapping the two root families selects the wrong half-space modes and silently produces a scattering matrix with the wrong boundary data.

mutations.title: wrong material units (Pa entered as GPa)
mutations.detector: the implied longitudinal speed must leave the physically admissible band
mutations.rationale: A silent 1000x unit error changes every dimensionless group.

mutations.title: inappropriate isotropic benchmark on an anisotropic medium
mutations.detector: PZT-5H must be shown to violate sagittal isotropy
mutations.rationale: The Fresnel formula is only valid for isotropic media; PZT-5H is not.
mutations.evidence: an isotropic closed form was evaluated on PZT-5H, which is not isotropic: R 0.0726435209266035 T 0.9273564790733965 SUM 1.0
mutations.control_evidence: no isotropic proxy present, so nothing was misapplied

mutations.title: incorrect interface sign (transmitted block sign lost)
mutations.detector: the 8x8 interface operator must not retain full rank
mutations.rationale: The transmitted half-space contributes with the opposite sign; losing it makes two columns degenerate.
mutations.evidence: interface operator rank with the sign defect: 8 (rank is INSENSITIVE to this defect); sign defect present in the assembled operator: True
mutations.control_evidence: interface operator rank with the sign defect: 8 (rank is INSENSITIVE to this defect); sign defect present in the assembled operator: False

mutations.title: decoupled electrostatic mode mislabelled as a gauge
mutations.detector: SCTA03: D_z = -eps33*k makes the mode physical and admissible
mutations.rationale: Found for real: this deleted the electrostatic channel of an elastic half-space while keeping the piezoelectric one.

mutations.title: strict Im(xi) != 0 radiation test
mutations.detector: SCTA04: PZT-5H must retain an incident channel at theta > 0
mutations.rationale: Found for real: no PZT-5H mode was INCOMING at theta > 0, so the coupled problem had no incident wave.

mutations.title: same-sign continuity in the assembly
mutations.detector: SCTA05: the reconstructed interface field must be continuous
mutations.rationale: Found for real: the solve residual stayed at 1e-37 while the interface was violated by 2x the incident state.

mutations.title: pure gauge admitted as a physical channel
mutations.detector: SCTA02: no gauge may enter the basis
mutations.rationale: A null channel must never be counted as a physical amplitude.

mutations.title: shear rows removed on the basis alone (rhs not tested)
mutations.detector: SCTR01: the u_x and txz rows carry the shear mode
mutations.rationale: The original Task 2 defect. A row may be dropped only when it is zero across the basis AND on the incident right-hand side.
mutations.evidence: the basis-only row deletion it targeted was removed by the Task 2U repair; the equivalent shear-row defect is MR24

mutations.title: P-wave u_x = 0 generalised to every mode
mutations.detector: SCTR02: a component zero on one wave is not zero on all
mutations.rationale: The single inference that produced the whole normal-incidence error.
mutations.evidence: the unscoped gauge rule it targeted was removed by the Task 2U repair; the equivalent ux/txz loss is MR24

mutations.title: quiet rows discarded as if they were empty
mutations.detector: SCTR03: removal must not change the rank
mutations.rationale: A row that is merely SMALL is not a row that is ZERO. Removing it leaves fewer equations than unknowns.

mutations.title: duplicate modal column admitted
mutations.detector: SCTR04: no two admitted columns may be proportional
mutations.rationale: Two names for one degree of freedom make the coefficients non-unique for no physical reason.

mutations.title: gauge condition posed as a boundary condition
mutations.detector: SCTR05: a gauge is not a physical non-uniqueness
mutations.rationale: phi1 = phi2 with one side carrying no potential forces the transmitted field to zero.
mutations.evidence: the old phi-as-boundary-condition rule was removed by the Task 2U repair; the equivalent defect is MR22 (no [[phi]] reconstruction)

mutations.title: same-sign continuity across the interface
mutations.detector: SCTR06: matched media must not reflect
mutations.rationale: The historical Task 2 sign defect, re-injected.

mutations.title: removed-row diagnostics report rhs as zero without checking
mutations.detector: SCTR07: the physical basis and the incident datum are both checked
mutations.rationale: A converged solve is not a correct solve.
mutations.evidence: the drop-without-checking rule was removed by the Task 2U repair; equivalent defects are MR22/MR23

mutations.title: relative potential offset treated as free
mutations.detector: EQ-02A-GAUGE-A6: the bonded model is not the insulated model
mutations.rationale: A free relative offset is an interface charge sheet; a bonded contact has none. Keeping the phi row solvable hides it.
mutations.evidence: the old emptiness-conditioned phi rule was removed by the Task 2U repair; the relative-offset defect is MR22

mutations.title: D_z continuity imposed at k = 0 as bonded
mutations.detector: EQ-02A-GAUGE-A6: the discarded row is the insulated condition
mutations.rationale: Imposing D_z across the interface silently converts a bonded joint into an insulated one.
mutations.evidence: the old emptiness-conditioned Dz rule was removed by the Task 2U repair; the kept-identity-row defect is MR23

mutations.title: global gauge condition removed from the full system
mutations.detector: EQ-02A-GAUGE-A2: exactly one gauge condition is required
mutations.rationale: Two constants with no fixing row leave a one-parameter family; reporting a unique answer then reports a gauge choice.

mutations.title: unit normalisation removed, raw SI columns span 1e59
mutations.detector: SCTR04: no two admitted columns may be proportional
mutations.rationale: The measured Task 2S production defect: q_z ~ 1e19 dominates, u_x is annihilated at 1e-14 and distinct columns look identical.

mutations.title: dielectric contact replaced by a conducting electrode
mutations.detector: EQ-02A-MAXW-01/02: a conductor terminates D_z, it does not transmit it
mutations.rationale: Imposing both potential and D_z continuity on a conductor over-constrains a model whose charge is free.

mutations.title: D_z continuity discarded with no derivation
mutations.detector: EQ-02A-MAXW-02: the row is dropped only where it is empty
mutations.rationale: Dropping a physical condition to make the system square is the failure mode this task exists to prevent.

mutations.title: zero free charge imposed when a charge is prescribed
mutations.detector: EQ-02A-MAXW-01: PRESCRIBED_CHARGE must carry sigma_given
mutations.rationale: Silently zeroing sigma imposes a different physical interface.

mutations.title: global gauge confused with a relative potential jump
mutations.detector: EQ-02A-MAXW-02/03: a jump is physical, a gauge shift is not
mutations.rationale: A gauge shift adds the same constant to both sides; a jump does not.

mutations.title: eigenvector rescaling treated as physical divergence
mutations.detector: EQ-02A-LIM-01: the 1/k is a normalisation artefact
mutations.rationale: The original Task 2S error, re-injected.

mutations.title: k=0 limit validated from a single finite-k sample
mutations.detector: EQ-02A-LIM-02/03: a limit needs a sequence
mutations.rationale: One sample cannot distinguish a limit from a value.

mutations.title: finite potential jump declared admissible at k=0
mutations.detector: EQ-ACPT01/02: the continuous-potential benchmark forbids it
mutations.rationale: k[phi]=0 at k=0 makes the jump UNDETECTABLE, not permitted.

mutations.title: basis chosen by a fitted numeric threshold
mutations.detector: EQ-ACPT04/06: mode retention must not depend on a constant
mutations.rationale: A threshold tuned until the answer looks right decides which modes exist, which is a physical judgement in numerical clothing.

mutations.title: incident amplitude pinned, hiding the cross-basis scale
mutations.detector: EQ-ACPT05: totals differ by exactly the incident factor
mutations.rationale: Reading that difference as a solver contradiction is the error this checkpoint made and caught.

mutations.title: incident-amplitude-dependent phi removal re-injected (BLK-02A-26 defect)
mutations.detector: ACPT02 must FAIL on the mutated tree
mutations.rationale: The pre-repair rule deleted the phi row when the incident wave carried no potential; the repair removed that dependence, and this mutation proves the test still catches it.

mutations.title: phi row removed at k=0 but [[phi]]=0 never reconstructed (BLK-02A-26 re-injected)
mutations.detector: ACPT02: the [[phi]] contact residual must be machine zero
mutations.rationale: Removing the row without the relative-gauge reconstruction is exactly the defect the Task 2U repair removed.

mutations.title: verified on-shell D_z row kept at k=0 (7x6 system)
mutations.detector: ACPT02/ACPT07: the k=0 system must be the square 6x6
mutations.rationale: Keeping an identity row makes the system overdetermined; solving it anyway returns a number that satisfies nothing physical.

mutations.title: shear traction row dropped from the production assembly
mutations.detector: ACPT07/ACPT08: shear residuals must be machine zero
mutations.rationale: Dropping a physical row to make the system square is the forbidden move; the SV channel must be constrained.

mutations.title: incident RHS sign flipped in the production assembly
mutations.detector: ACPT07/ACPT08: fields must match the k->0 limit
mutations.rationale: A sign-flipped RHS solves to machine residual and is wrong by exactly 2x the incident field -- only recomputed physical residuals catch it.

mutations.title: outgoing/incoming swapped in the production radiation classifier
mutations.detector: ACPT07/ACPT08: the selected modes must reproduce the limit
mutations.rationale: The incident channel must not be admitted as outgoing; swapping the labels changes which wave is driven.

mutations.title: Lord-Shulman g misplaced (q ~ kappa*g instead of kappa/g), probed at synthetic omega*tau ~ 2
mutations.detector: the LS identity (1-i w tau) q = -kappa grad theta must hold
mutations.rationale: At the physical omega*tau ~ 1e-6 the misplacement is below every tolerance; only a synthetic-tau probe exercises it. Synthetic tau is an algorithmic stress test, never a measured property.

mutations.title: electrostatic mode dropped at k>0 (labelled GAUGE, deleting the decoupled Laplace branch)
mutations.detector: ACPT07/ACPT08: the finite-k solve must keep 8 admissible modes and reproduce the k->0 limit
mutations.rationale: Mislabeling the electrostatic branch as a null gauge channel is exactly the dropped-electrostatic-mode failure mode of Task 2U-W; the finite-k contact solve loses the D_z constraint.
